questions.prompt: Does PowerShell `switch` stop processing automatically after the first matching case?

options.a: No — it falls through; multiple cases can run unless break or continue is used
options.b: Yes — it stops automatically after the first match like C or Java
options.c: Yes — unless the -All flag is passed

questions.prompt: Which parameter option makes `switch` case labels evaluate as regular expressions?

options.a: Reads the file line-by-line, evaluating each line as $_
options.b: Matches against the file's filename string
options.c: Compiles the script to a binary executable
